checks: For each coefficient-consistent valid bound F_i=u^2+gamma_i*r^2+a_i*u+b_i*r+c_i, the u secant is an upper bound with error at most width(u)^2/4.
For gamma_i>=0 the radial secant is upper with error at most gamma_i*width(r)^2/4; for gamma_i<0 the midpoint tangent is upper with error at most -gamma_i*width(r)^2/4.
Uniform error control passes to pointwise minima: min(F_i)<=min(U_i)<=min(F_i)+epsilon, using the minimizer of F_i for the latter inequality.

Closed affine dominance regions cover the entire clipped polygon including all ties. On each, the minimum is exactly one affine U_i, whose maximum occurs at an extreme point. Degenerate segments and points must be retained.
Selecting any nonempty valid subfamily raises its minimum and preserves upper-bound validity. No claim of the best envelope is needed to certify a nominated subfamily.
necessary_implementation_conditions: Partition at every native radial knot before fixing the quadratic coefficients.
Every moment constant must uniformly bound the same closed cumulant/shape child domain as every source plane on that piece.
Use each full profile with its own budget, target b, spectral gates, and source convention; do not mix coefficients from different profiles.
Enumerate all closed dominance-region vertices, including degenerate cases, and preserve every physical point in the source partition.
scope: Analytic lemma only. No proposed numerical hybrid bound is accepted by this record.
